topic: Hot take: opt-in AI for students is right. Tying it to Search isn't.
post:
Opt-in AI for students is the right call.
Tying it to Search is not. 🔥

Here's what happened:
Google announced that K-12 student accounts will have Gemini and Google Search switched off until a school admin turns them on.

On paper, that's great. Schools choose. 🏫

The catch:
Forbes and NBC News report that schools which say no to AI may also lose access to a plain, AI-free Search. Google says it will share more details with schools in the coming months.

My hot take 👇
An opt-in only means something if saying "no" doesn't cost you the basics.

If turning down AI also turns off search, that's not a choice. It's a bundle. 📦

Schools should be able to say:
✅ Yes to search
❌ No to AI, for now

Why it matters:
The defaults we set for kids today become the habits of the next workforce. They deserve a real choice, not a package deal.

Practical takeaway:
If you work with a school, ask your IT admin now: "Can we enable Search without AI features?" Get the answer in writing before the rollout. 📝

Agree or disagree? 👇

Follow for daily AI news you can actually use.
